about: The EPFO forms a PF Guru Ji reel may name (validate.py checks E3.14, E4.11 and E10.3), what each one is for, and where EPFO says so. A person checks each form on EPFO's page and records checked_by and checked_on, as for a fact. EPFO's 2026 Schemes don't name forms (claims go through the 'designated portal'), so the claim-form page is the source. Add a form only from EPFO's own page; forms 15G and 15H are gone (the Income-tax Act 2025 replaced them with Form 121, which isn't EPFO's).

forms.name: Form 19
forms.for: PF final settlement, by the member

forms.name: Form 10C
forms.for: Pension (EPS) withdrawal benefit or scheme certificate

forms.name: Form 13
forms.for: Moving an old PF account to the new one

forms.name: Form 20
forms.for: PF settlement for the nominee or heir of a member who has died

forms.name: Form 5IF
forms.for: EDLI insurance claim when a member dies in service
